title: Karoline Leavitt to Leave White House Press Secretary Role at the End of August
dek: President Trump announced the departure in a Truth Social post on August 12, saying Leavitt is leaving to spend more time with her family. No successor has been named.
author: The GoCheckMyNews Desk
key_fact: Leavitt, 28, the youngest person to hold the post, will leave at the end of August. Trump said she would remain one of his top outside advisers ahead of the midterm elections. A successor has not been named.

body: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt will leave the role at the end of August, President Trump announced in a Truth Social post on August 12.

Trump wrote that Leavitt is leaving so she can spend more time with her children and family, called her one of the best White House press secretaries in the history of the office, and thanked her for a job well done, according to reporting from NBC News, CNN and CNBC.

Leavitt is 28 and the youngest person to have held the post. The announcement comes less than a month after she returned from maternity leave and held her first briefing back; she had her second child in May, per the same reporting.

Trump said Leavitt would remain one of his top outside advisers and an influential voice in the Republican Party heading into the midterm elections. Outlets differ on nothing material here, and this desk found no reporting alleging a cause beyond the reason the president stated.

A successor has not been named, and none of the outlets carrying the announcement reported a shortlist. The desk will report a replacement when one is announced rather than speculate about candidates.
